local-phase-rotation-operator-8b14223a.title: Local Phase Rotation Operator
local-phase-rotation-operator-8b14223a.interpretation: Defines the point-dependent rotation of a complex matter field within the internal phase space of the subatomic vacuum.
local-phase-rotation-operator-8b14223a.symmetry_origin: The $U(1)$ gauge group acting on the fibers of a principal bundle over the spacetime manifold.
local-phase-rotation-operator-8b14223a.limits_and_boundary: Generalizes the global phase shift to a local transformation where the parameter $lpha$ is a continuous function of position.

cpt-theorem-mass-invariance-3156ff2d.title: CPT Mass Invariance
cpt-theorem-mass-invariance-3156ff2d.interpretation: Asserts that the mass and lifetime of a particle must be exactly equal to those of its antiparticle under the combined CPT transformation.
cpt-theorem-mass-invariance-3156ff2d.symmetry_origin: The foundational requirements of locality, Lorentz invariance, and Hermitian Hamiltonian structure in QFT.
cpt-theorem-mass-invariance-3156ff2d.limits_and_boundary: Proves that CP violation must be compensated by T violation (Time Reversal) to preserve the global CPT symmetry.

coordinate-energy-killing-field-d4da4689.title: Coordinate Energy Definition
coordinate-energy-killing-field-d4da4689.interpretation: Defines the energy of a particle relative to a stationary observer at infinity, where xi is the temporal Killing vector and p is the four-momentum.
coordinate-energy-killing-field-d4da4689.symmetry_origin: The time-translation symmetry of a stationary spacetime manifold.
coordinate-energy-killing-field-d4da4689.limits_and_boundary: Inside the static limit of a rotating black hole, xi becomes spacelike, mathematically allowing for negative values of E.
